Add a test that checks the engine copy

Source: R/use-vanilla.R
use_vanilla_test.Rd

Writes the test file tests/testthat/test-vanilla-engine.R in the package whose root is path. The test fails when an engine file differs from the lock inst/inlavanilla.lock, when a file in the lock is missing, or when a file R/vanilla-*.R is not in the lock, so that devtools::test() catches an edit to a copy. It uses base R and testthat only: the package does not need inlavanilla to run it.

The test reads the source files in R/, which an installed package does not hold. So it runs with devtools::test() from the source tree, and skips under R CMD check.

It is optional: use_vanilla() does not add it, and offers it at the end of its list. The package must already use testthat, as usethis::use_testthat() sets up.

Usage

use_vanilla_test(path = ".", overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

path

The root of the package, or a folder inside it. By default the working directory.

overwrite

If TRUE, replace a test file of that name that differs from the one this version of inlavanilla writes. By default such a file is left alone, with a message.

Value

Invisibly, the path of the test file.

See also

vanilla_status(), which also checks the lock against its release, the names and DESCRIPTION.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# From the root of a package that holds a copy of the engine
use_vanilla_test()
} # }
